# Contributing to Baraja Generator

Thanks for your interest in contributing to Baraja! We welcome bug reports, feature requests, and questions.

## Reporting Bugs

Before filing a bug report:
1. Search [existing issues](https://github.com/fernandomedrano/langcaster-2/issues) to avoid duplicates
2. Update to the latest version of Baraja Generator
3. Try to reproduce the issue with a fresh setup

**To report a bug:**
1. Click [New Issue](https://github.com/fernandomedrano/langcaster-2/issues/new/choose)
2. Select "Bug Report"
3. Fill out the template completely
4. Include console output or error messages if available

## Requesting Features

**Before requesting a feature:**
1. Check the [product roadmap](../docs/product-roadmap.md) to see if it's already planned
2. Consider which product it fits into:
   - **Baraja Generator (v1.x):** Simple deck generation (current)
   - **Baraja Designer (v2.x):** Pattern-based curriculum builder (future)
   - **Baraja Notebook (v3.x):** Personal pattern library (future)

**To request a feature:**
1. Click [New Issue](https://github.com/fernandomedrano/langcaster-2/issues/new/choose)
2. Select "Feature Request"
3. Explain the problem you're trying to solve
4. Describe your proposed solution

## Asking Questions

**To get help:**
1. Click [New Issue](https://github.com/fernandomedrano/langcaster-2/issues/new/choose)
2. Select "Help / Question"
3. Provide context about what you're trying to do
4. Include your app version and macOS version

## Code Contributions

We're not accepting code contributions for v1.0 yet. Focus is on:
- Stabilizing the current release
- Gathering user feedback
- Planning v2.0 (Designer)

Check back later for contribution guidelines when we're ready for community development.

## Product Roadmap

See [docs/product-roadmap.md](../docs/product-roadmap.md) for details on:
- v1.0 Generator (current)
- v1.1 Multi-language support (in progress)
- v2.0 Designer (3-6 months)
- v3.0 Notebook (6-9 months)

## License

By contributing, you agree that your contributions will be licensed under the same license as the project.

## Questions?

Not sure where to start? Open a "Help / Question" issue and we'll point you in the right direction.
